svg.title: northern development 2023 stacked reversed
svg.desc: Original source vector extraction. Source: https://www.northerndevelopment.bc.ca/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/NDIT_2023-AR-_Web.pdf; PDF page 51; crop in page points [262, 511, 350, 574]. Native PDF paths and shadings converted with Poppler pdftocairo. Gradient shadings retained as SVG linearGradient elements; no bitmap approximation.
